name: @markantolang/parser
description: Markanto reference parser — reads familiar Markdown tolerantly, models it in a strict semantic AST, and serialises exactly one canonical form per meaning
author: Michael Kortstiege

scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tools/migrate/tsconfig.json && node scripts/check-compat-boundary.mjs && node scripts/check-shipped-deps.mjs
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run corpus && bun test
scripts.verify:node: node scripts/validate-corpus.mjs && node --test test/unit/*.test.mjs && tsc -p test/compat/tsconfig.node.json && node --test .compat-dist/test/compat/compat.test.js && tsc -p test/import/tsconfig.node.json && node --test .import-dist/test/import/import.test.js && tsc -p test/migrate/tsconfig.node.json && node --test '.migrate-dist/test/migrate/*.test.js'
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run check && bun run build && bun test && bun run verify:node
